observations: Photo 0: a 3-seater sofa in brown/taupe fabric with large tears and holes on the seat cushions, exposing dark green material underneath (likely foam or lining).
Photo 0: armrest area also shows a worn patch and possible small tear.
Photo 0: text overlay reads 'POSTED ON JIJI HIGH TOWER', a watermark from a listing site, not seller-verified info.
Photo 1: a 2-seater sofa in similar brown/taupe fabric, seat and back look intact with no visible tears, but some dark staining on the seat cushion.
Both sofas have a diamond-quilted stitching pattern on the armrests, matching in style, suggesting a set.
A cloth or wrap (orange/gold) is draped over the backrests in both photos, not part of the sofas.
Wooden frame, springs, or internal structure are not visible in either photo; only fabric and foam are shown.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows visible tears and holes in the fabric of the 3-seater

claims.claim: All d wood inside are still intact
claims.evidence: No photo shows the internal wooden frame; it is hidden beneath fabric and foam in both photos

risks.risk: Wooden frame could be cracked, broken, or termite-damaged despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Photo or video of the frame with fabric/foam removed, or at least underside of the sofas
risks.if_unproven: priced as if frame condition is unknown/needs inspection, not taking seller's word as given

risks.risk: Foam and springs under the torn fabric on the 3-seater may be degraded or missing
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the exposed interior through the tears
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full reupholstery and foam replacement

risks.risk: 2-seater sofa may have hidden tears or damage not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Additional photos of the 2-seater from other angles, including underside and back
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn but structurally unknown, same tier as visible damage

risks.risk: Odor, mold, or pest infestation inside cushions not detectable from photos
risks.proof: Seller statement on smell/condition plus close-up of any staining or mold spots
risks.if_unproven: priced as if contamination risk present, lowering value further

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the wooden frame with cushions/fabric pulled back
Close-up photos of the torn areas on the 3-seater to assess foam/spring condition
Additional angles of the 2-seater (back, underside, sides) to check for hidden damage
Any photo showing both pieces together to confirm they are a matching set
response.reason: Both sofas are identifiable by type as a 3-seater and 2-seater set; the 3-seater shows clear fabric damage visible in photo 0, and the unverified wood-frame claim is priced conservatively as unconfirmed rather than blocking a price.
